answer_1.quote: we extend it to the Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction (ASQP) task . ASQP aims to predict four elements: aspect term, aspect category, opinion term, and sentiment polarity.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics are precision (P), recall (R), and F1 based on the exact match of the aspect and its sentiment polarity.

answer_3.quote: we design a puzzle-like experiment. Specifically, for each test sample, we manually construct different error outputs based on the label and error level definitions. We randomly select two or three error outputs as candidate options, then shuffle their order and ask the methods (based on LLaMA3-8B) to identify the acceptable one.
